title: Tech for Impact Summit 2025: Asia's Premier Cardano Event

ms.promise:
This milestone includes the following key activities:
1. Selecting Venues
・Research and Shortlist Venues: Identify suitable locations based on event size, accessibility, and facilities.
・Negotiate Terms and Costs: Work with venue providers to agree on rental terms, costs, and any included services (e.g., catering, security, AV equipment).
・Book Venue: Finalize the booking, ensuring all contractual details are clear.

2. Manage Event Registration and Participants
・Define Target Audience: Identify the expected demographic, including industry professionals, academics, stakeholders, and enthusiasts.
・Create Registration Process: Set up an online registration platform. Consider early bird, standard, and late registration phases.
・Plan for Accommodation and Travel: Provide information on nearby hotels and travel options.
・Manage Participant Communication: Regularly update participants on event details, and provide essential information like schedules, and maps.
ms.criteria:
The acceptance criteria for this milestone are as follows:
・The event venue is booked: Provide the name and address of the venue, along with a document proving that it has been booked for the event. This document will be saved on our Google Drive and will be publicly viewable.
・The event registration link is available: Share the event's registration link, which will be publicly available for any community member to register.

We are pleased to submit the deliverables for Milestone 2: Event Website and After-Party Venue for the Tech for Impact Summit 2025.

 https://drive.google.com/file/d/16wMI5UXmMD2XpFxm4rqdRIq8pfLndprF/view?usp=sharing

 The speakers and agenda will follow the same style as last year. We will invite the same speakers from last year to present again (subject to minor changes).
 Please refer to the attached document for details:
 https://tech4impactsummit.com/agenda
